name: GND Via Stitching
description: Automatically places ground via stitches in a neat grid (L→R, T→B), avoiding all traces, pads, and footprints.
description_full: Places via stitches on the GND net in a configurable grid pattern. Respects board outline, existing traces, pads, and footprint bounding boxes. Supports layer selection and preview mode before committing. Built and tested on KiCad 10.0.
